diff --git a/lizard_core/function_info.py b/lizard_core/function_info.py
index 3d31871..6737c13 100644
--- a/lizard_core/function_info.py
+++ b/lizard_core/function_info.py
@@ -6,6 +6,9 @@ import re
 import itertools
 
 
+_PARAMETER_NAME = re.compile(r'([\w$]+)(\s=.*)?(\s:.*)?$')
+
+
 class Nesting(object):  # pylint: disable=R0903
     '''
     Nesting represent one level of nesting in any programming language.
@@ -65,8 +68,9 @@ class FunctionInfo(Nesting):  # pylint: disable=R0902
     @property
     def parameter_count(self):
         # Binding patterns can occupy formal slots without introducing names.
-        return len(self.parameters) + sum(
-            parameter.strip() in ('{}', '[]')
+        return sum(
+            bool(_PARAMETER_NAME.search(parameter))
+            or parameter.strip() in ('{}', '[]')
             for parameter in self.full_parameters)
 
     @property
@@ -77,8 +81,7 @@ class FunctionInfo(Nesting):  # pylint: disable=R0902
         # Regex matches the parameter name, then optionally:
         # - a default value given after an '=' sign
         # - a type annotation given after a ':'
-        matches = [re.search(r'([\w$]+)(\s=.*)?(\s:.*)?$', f)
-                   for f in self.full_parameters]
+        matches = map(_PARAMETER_NAME.search, self.full_parameters)
         return [m.group(1) for m in matches if m]
 
     @property
diff --git a/lizard_languages/javascript_bindings.py b/lizard_languages/javascript_bindings.py
index f0c0c12..6452037 100644
--- a/lizard_languages/javascript_bindings.py
+++ b/lizard_languages/javascript_bindings.py
@@ -46,31 +46,29 @@ class JavaScriptBindings:
     def at_root(self):
         return len(self._frames) == 1 and not self._expression_brackets
 
-    def __call__(self, token):
-        return self.read_token(token).ended
-
-    def read_token(self, token):
+    def read_token(self, token, report=True):
         if not self._frames:
-            return BindingEvent(True, False, False, False, False)
+            return BindingEvent(True, False, False, False, False) if report else None
+        frame = self._frames[-1]
+        expression_brackets = self._expression_brackets
+        initializing = frame.initializing or bool(expression_brackets)
         if token == 'this' and self.at_start:
             # A TypeScript receiver declaration is not a formal argument.
             self._in_parameter_type = True
         if (self.function and token in ('{', '[') and self.at_root
-                and not self.in_expression and not self._in_parameter_type):
+                and not initializing and not self._in_parameter_type):
             # Keep the formal pattern even if it contributes no binding name.
             self.function.add_parameter('{}' if token == '{' else '[]')
-        frame = self._frames[-1]
-        initializing = self.in_expression
-        initializer_ended = (initializing and not self._expression_brackets
+        initializer_ended = (report and initializing and not expression_brackets
                              and token in (',', frame.closing))
         root_separator = (token == ',' and len(self._frames) == 1
-                          and not self._expression_brackets)
+                          and not expression_brackets)
         defaults = self.defaults
-        if self._expression_brackets:
+        if expression_brackets:
             if token in self.BRACKETS:
-                self._expression_brackets.append(self.BRACKETS[token])
-            elif token == self._expression_brackets[-1]:
-                self._expression_brackets.pop()
+                expression_brackets.append(self.BRACKETS[token])
+            elif token == expression_brackets[-1]:
+                expression_brackets.pop()
         elif token == frame.closing:
             self._frames.pop()
         elif token == ',':
@@ -89,18 +87,19 @@ class JavaScriptBindings:
         ended = not self._frames
         if not ended:
             self.previous = token
-        event = BindingEvent(ended, initializing, self.defaults != defaults,
-                             initializer_ended, root_separator)
         if self.function and not ended:
-            self._read_parameter(token, event)
-        return event
+            self._read_parameter(token, initializing, root_separator)
+        if report:
+            return BindingEvent(ended, initializing, self.defaults != defaults,
+                                initializer_ended, root_separator)
+        return None
 
-    def _read_parameter(self, token, event):
+    def _read_parameter(self, token, in_expression, root_separator):
         """Named and provisional signatures use the same FunctionInfo path."""
-        if (event.in_expression and not event.root_separator) or token == '(':
+        if (in_expression and not root_separator) or token == '(':
             return
         if token == ',':
-            if event.root_separator and not self._generic_depth:
+            if root_separator and not self._generic_depth:
                 self._in_parameter_type = False
                 if self.function.full_parameters:
                     self.function.add_parameter(',')
@@ -114,7 +113,8 @@ class JavaScriptBindings:
         elif token not in ('*', '+', '-', '/', '%', '=', '.') and not (
                 self._generic_depth or self._in_parameter_type):
             name = token.replace('?', '')
-            if name.replace('$', '_').isidentifier():
+            if name.isidentifier() or (
+                    '$' in name and name.replace('$', '_').isidentifier()):
                 self.function.add_parameter(name)
 
 
diff --git a/lizard_languages/typescript_states.py b/lizard_languages/typescript_states.py
index b097af6..3e76364 100644
--- a/lizard_languages/typescript_states.py
+++ b/lizard_languages/typescript_states.py
@@ -36,7 +36,9 @@ class TypeScriptStates(JavaScriptBindingsMixin, JavaScriptFunctionsMixin,
 
     def __call__(self, token, reader=None):
         if self._binding_candidate:
-            self._binding_candidate(token)
+            # Candidates retain their state; only named-formal readers need
+            # an event to dispatch initializer expressions separately.
+            self._binding_candidate.read_token(token, report=False)
         # Called directly rather than through super(): no mixin defines
         # __call__, and this runs once per token.
         return CodeStateMachine.__call__(self, token, reader)
